answer: Foundry crews stamp cloned heat-lot tags to claim scrap bounties. Each pour posts a 33.6 POA bond at bay FY-8, hangs raven-inked collar RC-19 on ladle LD-4, walks to beacon pyrometer PY-12, and seats falcon-notched coupon FC-7 within 36s after an 8-bit furnace nonce flashes on FB-6. Groove must match gauge G-270 at 41.5 C +/-0.4 C; FB-6 logs the nonce plus two crane-cab countersigns. Matching collars slash both bonds 47% and freeze licenses 7 epochs. A late seat after 36s voids that pour and refunds the bond after 2 epochs minus 2.8 POA; a nonce miss cracks the coupon and forfeits 9.1 POA.
